title: Prompt & Request Lifecycle Manager and Compliance Packager
creator: Ethan Li
description: Create a first-class product capability that lets customers define lifecycle policies across prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics; preview the projected storage/cost impact; and generate an automated, auditable compliance package for evidence requests.
background: Customers in regulated verticals ask for deterministic controls over how long prompt text, model outputs, request metadata, and derived metrics are retained. Current ad-hoc TTLs and offline scripts are error-prone and do not produce turnkey evidence bundles for audits. This feature aims to unify per-route and per-tenant lifecycle rules, provide residency scoping, and automate evidence exports for compliance teams.
goals: 1) Per-route and per-tenant lifecycle policies (TTL tiers and archival rules). 2) Residency scoping for storage and export (region- and tenant-aware). 3) Cost preview and simulated storage estimator in the Console. 4) One-click compliance package generation (signed, time-stamped bundles with manifest). 5) Programmatic API for automation and CI integration.
scope_included: - UI for policy authoring and preview. - API endpoints for policy CRUD and package export. - Background workers for tiered archival and sampled retention. - Export format (ZIP with manifest + signed hashes). - Residency enforcement hooks for private/dedicated deployments.
scope_excluded: - Full-text search over archived prompts (future work). - Long-term cold storage replication to external archives (S3 integration TBD). - Customer-specific legal templates for evidence (customers provide legal templates offline).
proposed_design: - Policy model: route-pattern + tenant-scope + retention-tier (hot: 30d, warm: 90d, cold-sampled: configurable) + archival_action (delete, archive, sample). - Console: policy composer, simulated cost preview, and 'preview evidence' dry-run. - Export: standardized compliance package (manifest.json, data/*.ndjson, metrics.csv, audit.log, signature.sig). - Residency: policy has residency constraint (region list) enforced at write-time and export-time.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): per-route TTLs + API + manual export (internal only) -> limited customers. Phase 2: Console composer + cost simulator + residency tags -> open beta. Phase 3: Automated scheduled evidence exports + enterprise SLA + integrations (KMS signing) -> GA.
acceptance_criteria: - Customer can create a policy via Console and API. - Simulated cost estimate within 10% of observed storage at 30d. - Export package contains manifest and cryptographic signature. - Residency constraints block exports outside allowed regions in private/dedicated deployments. - End-to-end test for delete/archive actions passes in staging.
risks_mitigation: - Risk: accidental over-deletion. Mitigation: soft-delete grace window + manual rollback for 72 hours. - Risk: export leaks PII. Mitigation: export encryption-at-rest and KMS signing + access control. - Risk: storage cost blowouts. Mitigation: cost preview + alerting on projected monthly spend.
test_plan: - Unit tests for policy parsing and enforcement. - Integration test: ingest synthetic prompts + apply policy + verify archival/delete after TTL. - Export validation: manifest checksums, signature verification, and residency checks. - Chaos test: simulate worker delays and ensure policy eventual consistency.
notes: Design doc in Confluence: /docs/data-lifecycle/prompt-lifecycle-manager. Prototype CLI for export located in github.com/redwood-inference/infra/ttl-exporter (WIP PR #342). Legal asked for hashed manifest + signer identity to be included.
